## Schools, keynotes and organising

**AIM-CC 2026 — "AI & Methods in Computational Communication"** · 8–16 August 2026, Astana. Young-scholar conference and research school co-organised by Kazakhstan Sociology Lab, Nazarbayev University and the International Communication Association, funded by Kazakhstan's Ministry of Science and Higher Education, with seven international instructors. *Co-organiser.*

**International Winter School, "Research Practice in Sociology and Social Work for Quality Education and the Promotion of the SDGs in Kazakhstan"** · 17–18 January 2026, Al-Farabi Kazakh National University, Almaty. *Keynote speaker*, problem-lecture on the crisis of the contemporary social sciences.

**"Days of the Institute for the Rule of Law in Yerevan"** · 14–16 March 2024. *Lecturer*, "New Surveillance, Old Challenges."

**EUSP R-meetup group** · 2020–2022. *Organiser.*
